_help: Clue text for generated levels (Mamie's old treasure hunts). The generator picks a riddle depth 0-4 per lock from tiers.json 'riddle'. Depth 0-1 use the plain templates below ('0'..'3', split clues 'first'/'last'). Depth 2+ build riddles: facts, counting things in the room (counters), sums, number patterns, and logic statements (for symbol tunes, lamps and orders). Placeholders: {lock} name of the lock, {code} 4 7 2, {part} part of a code, {words} four, seven, two, {reversed} 2 7 4, {seq} symbols, {seq_reversed}, {time} 7:30, {time_words} half past seven, {time_before} / {time_after} one hour earlier / later, {on} / {off} lamps on / off, {count} how many numbers, {parts} the riddle parts, {shown} the numbers of a pattern, {statements} logic sentences, {base} and {offset} times. Write {sun} etc. for symbol icons. The level validator fails if a placeholder is left over.

statements._help: One sentence per logic statement. {a} {b} {c} are symbols, {ord} is first/second/..., {k} a number word.
next_to: {a} and {b} are next to each other.
not_next_to: {a} and {b} are not next to each other.
same: The {a} and {b} lamps are both on, or both off.
different: Exactly one of the {a} and {b} lamps is on.
if_on_then_on: If the {a} lamp is on, the {b} lamp is on too.
not_both: The {a} and {b} lamps are never on together.
count: {k} lamps glow, no more, no fewer.

counters._help: Props that show a number of things (1-9). Riddles ask you to count them. phrase: how a riddle names them. text: what the close-up says.
